# MOTIL Mining OS — Sistema Operativo para Minería

MOTIL is a modular Mining Operating System (Sistema Operativo para Minería) for mining operations in Chile, developed by Neuralia (N3URALIA). It connects production, maintenance, inventory, procurement, finance, HR, HSE and legal under one operational traceability, for mine sites in Chile, Peru and LATAM.

Canonical website: https://www.motil.app
Language: Spanish (Chile) with English mirror under /en
Market: Mining operations in Chile, Peru and LATAM

## What MOTIL does

MOTIL connects operational areas in one system with traceability and auditable evidence. It is designed around mining workflows rather than a generic ERP taxonomy — it is a Mining Operating System, not a horizontal ERP adapted afterwards.

## Commercial modules

- Production (Producción): mineral transport, plant, metallurgy, geology, topography, chemistry, drilling.
- Maintenance (Mantenimiento): work orders, mobile and static assets, planning, vehicles, workshop/Maestranza, maintenance history.
- Inventory (Inventario): stock, reservations, spare parts, replenishment, movements and traceability.
- Procurement (Compras): quotations, supplier comparison, purchase orders and approved suppliers.
- Finance (Finanzas): cost centers, commitments, operational costs and financial traceability.
- Human Resources (RRHH): people, employment assignments, competencies, performance, 360° work record and operational evidence.
- Sustainability and HSE (Sostenibilidad): risk prevention, inspections, PPE/EPP, environment, communities and compliance.
- Legal: contracts, documents, permits, expirations and compliance.

## Core concepts

- Mining Operating System / Sistema Operativo para Minería
- Modular mining software
- Operational traceability
- Canonical operational data
- Evidence-based workflows

## Entities

- MOTIL (also "MOTIL Mining OS"): Mining Operating System. Site: https://www.motil.app
- Neuralia (stylized N3URALIA): Chilean software and AI company, creator of MOTIL. Site: https://www.n3uralia.com
- Category: Mining Operating System — an operational layer connecting processes, people, assets, data, evidence and decisions of a mine site; distinct from a mining ERP, which focuses mainly on administrative and transactional processes.


## Public evidence policy

The /evidencia page is the canonical public surface for MOTIL capability scope and limitations. Operational customer data, private integrations and internal metrics are not public evidence by default. Material performance claims should include scope, period and verifiable provenance before citation.
